name: android_set_permission
description: Grants (grant: true) or revokes (grant: false) a runtime permission of an app. Revoking a granted permission makes Android kill the app process, so unsaved app state is lost.

grant.description: true to grant, false to revoke.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
